description.value: Red Umbrella Cafe is a locally-owned breakfast and lunch spot in Vancouver's West End, serving the neighbourhood since 2007 and rebranded under current owner Mitra Ameri in 2014. The cafe is known for homemade and handcrafted food — including all-day breakfast, creative lunch sandwiches, specialty coffee, and slow-roasted meats — using fresh, premium ingredients. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, and takeout is offered for those who prefer to eat on the move.
